messages.subject: Re: Residual Analysis
messages.body_plain:
You can use the ppmc function, to estimate the posterior distributions for desired residuals

For example for general residual indices, like srmr
### SRMR
srmr <- ppmc(fit52, thin = 2, fit.measures = c("srmr"))
summary(srmr)                 # summarize the whole vector in a data.frame
hist(srmr, element = "srmr") # only plot one discrepancy function at a time

You can then specify functions to extract more detailed residuals, any function you want to write your own or extract functions that lavaan can do. For example, for residual correlations
#### residual correlations
## define a list of custom discrepancy functions
## - (local) standardized residuals

discFUN_res <- list(
std.cov.resid = function(fit) lavResiduals(fit, zstat = FALSE,
                                           type = "cor.bollen",
                                           summary = FALSE)$cov,
std.mean.resid = function(fit) lavResiduals(fit, zstat = FALSE,
                                            type = "cor.bollen",
                                            summary = FALSE)$mean)

std_res <- ppmc(fit52, thin=5, discFUN = discFUN_res)

summary(std_res, discFUN = "std.cov.resid", central.tendency = "EAP")
hist(std_res, discFUN = "std.cov.resid", element = c(5,2))
plot(std_res, discFUN = "std.cov.resid", element = c("down","cheerful"))
## For ease of investigation, optionally export summary as a data.frame,
## sorted by size of average residual
summary(std_res, discFUN = "std.cov.resid", central.tendency = "EAP",
        to.data.frame = TRUE, sort.by <http://sort.by> = "EAP", decreasing=T)
## or sorted by size of PPP
summary(std_res, discFUN = "std.cov.resid", central.tendency = "EAP",
        to.data.frame = TRUE, sort.by <http://sort.by> = "PPP_sim_LessThan_obs")
